name: smart_chunking_finance_bench
description: A practical benchmark for evaluating chunking and retrieval strategies on long-form financial documents. It measures how well models (and chunking heuristics) enable accurate question answering and information extraction from lengthy finance texts by comparing downstream QA/response quality when different chunking methods are used. Useful for assessing retrieval-augmented generation and long-context handling in financial NLP pipelines.
evaluation_method: F1 (QA metrics; often reported with exact_match/Rouge)
reputation: Community-contributed HuggingFace dataset with limited but growing use for practical RAG/long-context experiments in finance.
